Burst of Speed.description: Beginning at 3rd level, a cavalier can push his mount beyond its normal charging speed. This doubles the maximum charging distance the mount can cover, up to four times its base speed. The first use each day imposes no ill effects on the mount. However, every subsequent use on the same day forces the mount to attempt a DC 20 Will save once the charge concludes; on a failure, the mount suffers 2d6 points of damage.

Courtly Knowledge.description: A cavalier applies his class level as a competence bonus to all Knowledge (nobility and royalty) checks.

Deadly Charge.description: Starting at 2nd level, a cavalier who is mounted and performing a charge action can declare a "deadly charge" prior to rolling his attack (meaning a missed attack wastes the attempt). On a successful hit, he inflicts triple damage with a melee weapon (or quadruple damage when wielding a lance). This benefit does not combine with the Spirited Charge feat.

Full Mounted Attack.description: Starting at 6th level, a cavalier riding a mount that moves more than 5 feet but no further than a single move action allows may execute a full attack. This full attack cannot be used in conjunction with a charge.

Mounted Weapon Bonus (Lance).description: While fighting from the saddle, a cavalier receives a competence bonus to attack rolls with the specified weapon. The lance bonus begins at +1 at 1st level and increases by an additional +1 for every four levels gained afterward. The sword bonus starts at +1 at 2nd level and likewise improves by +1 every four levels beyond that.

Ride Bonus.description: A cavalier receives a competence bonus to Ride checks, beginning at +2. This bonus increases to +4 at 4th level, +6 at 7th level, and +8 at 9th level.

Special Mount.description: For the purpose of determining a paladin's mount capabilities, a cavalier's levels in this class stack with any paladin levels the character possesses.

Unstoppable Charge.description: At 10th level, when performing a deadly charge, the cavalier inflicts quadruple damage with a melee weapon (or quintuple damage when using a lance).

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: A cavalier is proficient with all simple weapons, all martial weapons, every category of armor (light, medium, and heavy), and shields.
